To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cleavage synchrony from 2 to the 8th cell (CS2- 8) was the best predictor of blastocyst quality and formation, and it can be assessed on day 3.
“Relative kinetic expressions defining synchronicity are better indicators of blastogenesis than absolute timings”.
relative kinetics (t8-t3, t8-t5, CS2-8) were found to have a higher predictive value of blastocyst quality and development than absolute timings (t8) and time intervals (t8-t4, t8-t6).
In summary, our research is concerned with
the prediction of blastulation based on morphokinetics.
the identification of the best kinetic expression available on day 2 or 3 for the prediction of the embryo’s implantation potential.
the identification of a morphokinetic criterion that can predict blastocyst development and quality and can be used for the selection of embryos on day 3.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a combination of morphology and morphokinetic parameters is a better selection criterion for embryo transfer than either parameter alone.
the relative timing of the 2- to 8-cell cycle is a better predictor than absolute timings for blastocyst quality.
the relative timing of cleavage cycles is more important than absolute time points in the prediction of blastulation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
relative kinetic expressions defining cleavages synchronicity are better than absolute time points in predicting blastocyst formation.
relative kinetic expressions defining cleavity synchronicity are better indicators of blastcyst formation and quality, when compared to absolute timings.
“the more synchronized the cleavage cycles are, the more the embryos are likely to form a good-quality blastocyst”.
The main takeaway from our work is that
relative kinetics, which can be calculated from data already available up to the cleavage stage, may be a better predictor of implantation than absolute time-points.
a kinetic expression, CS2-8, available up to day 3 can predict blastocyst quality and formation with a high sensitivity and specificity.
a kinetic expression based on cleavage synchronicity is a good indicator of embryo development and can be used for embryo selection.
